f1.description: Reintroduce F1: drop the webhook event-id dedup, so a redelivered event credits the creator twice.
expectedFailures: F1 a redelivered event credits the creator once

f2.description: Reintroduce F2: unkey the ledger transaction, so two events for one occurrence credit twice.
expectedFailures: F2 two events for one occurrence credit the creator once

f3.description: Reintroduce F3: drop an out-of-order refund instead of parking it.
expectedFailures: F3 an out-of-order refund is applied once the capture exists

f4.description: Reintroduce F4: key refunds by the charge id, dropping a second partial refund.
expectedFailures: F4 a second partial refund is applied

f5.description: Reintroduce F5: round each refund line independently, drifting by cents.
expectedFailures: F5 a partial refund splits without rounding drift

f6.description: Reintroduce F6: reconcile by count instead of amount per creator.
expectedFailures: F6 reconciliation flags an amount drift per creator

f7.description: Reintroduce F7: a fresh idempotency key per capture attempt.
expectedFailures: F7 a lost capture response is retried with one idempotency key

f8.description: Reintroduce F8: a dispute leaves the referral reward paid.
expectedFailures: F8 a dispute reverses the referral reward

f9.description: Reintroduce F9: an unknown payout outcome is resent blindly.
expectedFailures: F9 an unknown payout outcome is looked up, not retried blindly
